mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.title, m.course_tag as courseTag, LEFT(o.ocr_text, 200) as ocrTextSnippet, m.source, m.created_at as createdAt FROM materials m LEFT JOIN ocr_result o ON m.id = o.material_id WHERE MATCH(m.title) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) OR MATCH(o.ocr_text) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
